notes.what: Episode manifest for the SACRED parity corpus (CLAUDE.md §Invariants). tanitad.data.parity asserts every trainer's loaded episode set against this file at startup.
notes.uid: episode uid = the ep_%05d.pt basename; the index is the position in the ordered source list (tanitad/data/epcache.py), so it is the stable identity WITHIN a build key.
notes.limitations: This pins WHICH episode slots are present. It does not hash episode CONTENT, so a same-name file with different tensor bytes is not detected here (the build key e438721ae894 and compute_skipset.py cover the build side).
notes.clip_membership: Added 2026-07-27 (v2-parity-enforcement). A V2 COMPRESSED cache (<clip_id>.v2ep.pt) has no ep_%05d.pt positions, so episode_uid_sha256 cannot be evaluated against it and register_geometry_sibling() correctly refuses it. clip_membership carries the corpus's CLIP-ID digest instead — the uid space a v2 cache actually has. See parity.py §9 (verify_v2_membership / register_v2_geometry_sibling / assert_v2_parity_cache) and scripts/register_v2_sibling.py.
